sample_unit: participants (35 providers in focus groups, 13 stakeholders in interviews)
models_evaluated: FluidCalc (DHAKA and NIRUDAK AI-based dehydration assessment models)
unlisted_practices: Assess barriers and facilitators to implementation of an AI-based clinical decision support tool using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research
Obtain Ministry of Health and facility leadership endorsement before implementation

screen.reason: This is a qualitative implementation study using CFIR (focus groups and interviews) with clinicians and stakeholders evaluating barriers and facilitators to the potential uptake and deployment of an AI-based CDST (FluidCalc).
